title: Regarding and Regardless
titleZh: 论及与否，抑或置之不理
credits: Andrew Smith wrote this lesson for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: This week on Ask a Teacher we answer a question from Ramatoulaye in Senegal.
sentences.zh: 本周在“向老师提问”栏目中，我们回答了来自塞内加尔的拉马图莱的问题。

sentences.en: Here is Ramatoulaye’s question:
sentences.zh: 以下是拉马图莱的问题：

sentences.en: Dear teacher,
sentences.zh: 尊敬的老师，

sentences.en: Thank you and all the VOA Learning English team for their great work!
sentences.zh: 感谢您和VOA英语学习团队所做出的出色工作！

sentences.en: My question is: what is the difference between “regarding” and “regardless?”
sentences.zh: 我的问题是：“regarding”和“regardless”有什么区别？

sentences.en: Thank you for your comments, Ramatoulaye.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您对拉马图莱的评论。

sentences.en: And I am happy to answer your question.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意回答您的问题。

sentences.en: Both words are very useful in speaking and writing.
sentences.zh: 这两个词在口语和书面语中都非常有用。

sentences.en: That’s because the words give us a quick way to connect to other ideas.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这些词为我们提供了一种快速连接其他想法的方式。

sentences.en: “Regarding” simply means what someone is talking or writing about.
sentences.zh: “regarding” simply means what someone is talking or writing about.

sentences.en: Consider the following two examples:
sentences.zh: 请看以下两个例子：

sentences.en: We have all the information we need about the project.
sentences.zh: 我们已经掌握了关于这个项目所需的全部信息。

sentences.en: We have all the information we need regarding the project.
sentences.zh: 我们已经掌握了关于这个项目所需的全部信息。

sentences.en: The word “regarding” in the second example means the same thing as the preposition “about” in the first example.
sentences.zh: 第二个例子中的“regarding”一词与第一个例子中的介词“about”意思相同。

sentences.en: We generally use the word “about” more than “regarding.”
sentences.zh: 我们通常比“regarding”更多地使用“about”。

sentences.en: However, it is more common to use “regarding” in formal speech than in informal communication.
sentences.zh: 然而，在正式场合中使用“regarding”比在非正式交流中更为常见。

sentences.en: Also, the expression “in regard to” means the same thing as “regarding.”
sentences.zh: 此外，“in regard to”这一表达与“regarding”意思相同。

sentences.en: Here are some examples:
sentences.zh: 以下是一些例子：

sentences.en: In regard to the price, I think it was too expensive.
sentences.zh: 关于价格，我认为太贵了。

sentences.en: In regard to what you said, I don’t think we know all the facts yet.
sentences.zh: 关于您所说的话，我认为我们尚未掌握全部事实。

sentences.en: Note that we use a noun, noun phrase, or noun clause after the expression “in regard to.”
sentences.zh: 请注意，在“in regard to”这一表达之后，我们通常会接名词、名词短语或名词性从句。

sentences.en: Also, you will sometimes hear native speakers say “in regards to” instead of “in regard to.”
sentences.zh: 此外，你有时也会听到母语者说“in regards to”，而不是“in regard to”。

sentences.en: Here is something you may find interesting when we compare the expression “in regard to” and the verb “regard.”
sentences.zh: 下面介绍一点在比较“in regard to”这一表达与动词“regard”时你可能会觉得有趣的内容。

sentences.en: The verb “regard” is a somewhat formal way to say, “look at.”
sentences.zh: 动词“regard”是一种较为正式的说法，意思是“看”。

sentences.en: So, just as we can direct someone’s attention to something by having them look at it, the expression “in regard to” directs us to something we are talking about.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如我们可以通过让别人去看某物来引导他们的注意力，表达“in regard to”也将我们引向我们所谈论的对象。

sentences.en: The word “regardless” expresses the idea that one or more things do not affect the current situation or what we want to express now.
sentences.zh: “regardless”一词表达了这样一层意思：一个或多个因素并不影响当前的情形或我们此刻想要表达的内容。

sentences.en: When you look at the word, you will see that it ends with the suffix -less.
sentences.zh: 当你观察这个词时，会发现它以后缀-less结尾。

sentences.en: This suffix means the same thing as the word “without.”
sentences.zh: 这一后缀的含义与单词“without”相同。

sentences.en: So, “regardless” means “without regard to.”
sentences.zh: 因此，“regardless”意为“不顾、不管”。

sentences.en: Consider the following examples.
sentences.zh: 请看以下例句。

sentences.en: Regardless of religion, all people want happiness.
sentences.zh: 无论宗教信仰如何，所有人都渴望幸福。

sentences.en: All people want happiness, regardless of religion.
sentences.zh: 所有人都渴望幸福，无论宗教信仰如何。

sentences.en: Notice that you can use the word “regardless” either before or after the sentence or phrase it modifies.
sentences.zh: 请注意，“regardless”一词既可以放在它修饰的句子或短语之前，也可以放在之后。

sentences.en: For our readers and listeners, what are your questions about American English?
sentences.zh: 各位读者和听众，你们对美国英语有什么疑问呢？

sentences.en: Regardless of your level of English, we want to hear from you!
sentences.zh: 无论你的英语水平如何，我们都希望听到你的声音！

sentences.en: Send us an email at learningenglish@voanews.com.
sentences.zh: 请给我们发送邮件至 learningenglish@voanews.com。

sentences.en: And please let us know where you are from, too.
sentences.zh: 同时，也请告知我们你来自哪里。

sentences.en: And that’s Ask a Teacher.
sentences.zh: 以上就是“向老师提问”节目。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。

glossary.def: in grammar, to limit or specify the meaning of another word
